Explain the example for turn clicks into a stream

blocks.text: fromEvent listens to events from a target. Each matching event becomes a stream value.
Use a JavaScript or TypeScript project with RxJS 7 installed. Run imports through the project tool. Browser event examples need the stated HTML element. This site does not include RxJS in its runner.

blocks.title: Turn clicks into a stream

blocks.text: Read the code step by step

items: `take` completes after the chosen number of emitted values. It counts values rather than elapsed seconds.
`fromEvent` turns target events into an observable. Its target must exist before you subscribe.
`querySelector` finds the first matching element. Check for a missing result when the element is optional.

blocks.text: The first two clicks log Chosen. The stream then stops listening.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: Check that the target exists. A missing element cannot be an event target.

blocks.title: Your small task
blocks.text: Click three times and count the messages.
